# Confirm repeated saves are announced each time

## What & Why
Screen-reader users may save several entries in one session. Add regression coverage for repeated answer and opportunity saves so the polite live region continues to communicate every completed action rather than only the first one.

## Done looks like
- Saving two answers in succession announces the save outcome for each action.
- Saving two opportunities in succession announces the save outcome for each action.
- Existing focus restoration remains intact.
